packaging: cargo package --no-verify of the base commit with the change below applied; .cargo_vcs_info.json records the local packaging commit
change: rewind_to_chain_state takes the pruning floor from the wallet's view of the chain tip (the end of the scan queue, or MAX(blocks.height) if higher), as its documentation already states, instead of MAX(blocks.height); successive rewinds with no scan in between no longer reach further down each time
the truncation height skips a checkpoint that a pool straddles while retaining only anchors below it; a pool that straddles it with an ordinary checkpoint below is still reported as corrupted
reason: Adding or importing accounts one after another with no scan in between failed with CorruptedData ("the Ironwood note commitment tree retains checkpoints both above and below height H, but none at that height to truncate to") once the pools' oldest checkpoints differed
license_texts: LICENSE-APACHE and LICENSE-MIT copied from the earlier vendored backport of this package, which took them from the zakura-client-backend 0.1.0-rc7 archive; the manifest declares MIT OR Apache-2.0
removal_condition: Move the wallet-libraries pin to a revision or release that contains upstream_merge_commit, then delete this directory and both zakura-client-sqlite patch entries in rust/Cargo.toml
